Name: Simplified Palette
Author: Zalinius0
Description:
A texture pack to replace the default one. It has a much smaller color palette, and gives the game a rustic feel.

This is a content pack, requiring Content Patcher and Smapi to function.
It [b]replaces [/b]all of the non internationalized textures in the game.
I've not played with it much yet (though I'm working on it c: ) so let me know if any of the sprites or textures seem weird or broken.



[font=Courier New][size=1]PS: The reason I don't  know if the textures are broken is because I made them with programming, More on that soon . . . [/size][/font]
